label: sec:qbeta-formalize-first-gates-intro
html:
Because the Frobenius collapse T_\beta = S\cdot\mathbf{1} (Min-Frobenius-norm collapse: T_β = S · 1 under the canonical Markov-trace inner product on H_n(R, q)) reduces the leading \beta-decay amplitude on H_3(q) to a scalar, the sub-leading precision coefficients c_k of the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta ladder (Complex-Volume Precision Ladder) must arise from a fibre-level Habiro kernel F(q). Rather than searching unconstrained rational expressions for c_k, this section establishes the algebraic invariance gates that any candidate kernel F(q) must satisfy over \mathbb{Q}(q) prior to archimedean evaluation:

  1. Classical vanishing and shadow gate: In the classical limit q \to 1, the ratio \mathfrak{Q}_\beta/E_0 vanishes while the normalized Taylor shadows reproduce c_2 \to -1 and c_3 \to J_{\mathrm{Hopf}}(1) = -2 (S(q) = \mathfrak{Q}_\beta(q)/E_0(q) vanishes at the classical point q = 1, \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder \S 4(c) shadow gate).
  2. Bar-even kernel invariance: The kernel modifying the bar-odd carrier must itself be bar-even under q \mapsto q^{-1} so that the expansion proceeds in integer powers of u = b\,\hbar_q^2 (\mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder \bar{}-even discriminant).
  3. Habiro q-difference and Jackson q-Bessel recursion: Any kernel in the Habiro ring satisfies a finite-order q-difference equation, inducing a C-finite contiguity recurrence on c_k bridged to the per-block z-recursion (c_k precision-ladder recursion induced by the fibre-level Habiro q-difference equation, Bridge: z-Taylor recursion vs c_k ladder recursion — structural correspondence).
  4. Radius-of-convergence and magnitude screens: The kernel's singularity locus and sign pattern are constrained by the radius-of-convergence and direction-sanity gates (\mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder \S 4(a) gate, The order-of-magnitude screen \mathrm{Scr}_\lambda(t,x), \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder \S 4(d) direction-sanity gate).
